rationale: Build directly on the current best late-aligned decoder-skip recurrent-tail script, but normalize the stored encoder skip states before the decoder reuses them. The winning path already depends on those late skips; this keeps the same topology, bytes, and wallclock behavior while making the skip additions more scale-stable for the final int8 roundtrip.
title: RMS-Normalized Late Decoder Skips For Recurrent Tail
